subjects.displayTitle: Mystical themes: wonder, transformation, and the fruits of love
subjects.introduction: The proof of a mystical experience, ‘Abdu’l-Bahá said, is its fruit. That plain sentence keeps company with some of the most intoxicated language in the Writings: a hundred thousand seas of glory surging in hearts whose lips look parched, a lover who calls himself the reed-flute and God the Player, wine poured by the Cup-Bearer of divine bounty, a Bird leaving the nest of silence for the air of divine melody. Bahá’u’lláh welcomes bewilderment and asks for more of it, yet He also insists that every invisible must have a visible manifestation and every word a meaning, since a word without meaning never bears fruit. So the ascent has conditions. No soul rises into that cloud except through love of God’s loved ones, and the annihilation of self ends not in silence but in spiritual growth and the guidance of others. Paul’s warning that knowledge of all mysteries is nothing without charity presses the same point from another tradition. From here the way opens into wine as a symbol of transformation, into the mystical vision itself, and into the symbolism and poetry through which such things can be said at all.
subjects.arc: Begin with spiritual fruits, discernment, and love for others; explore the limits of language and the stages of the inner journey; enter the images of longing, music, wine, and revelation; then return to gratitude, friendship, and service.

order.why: Open with the reported test of mystical experience through its fruits.
Ground exploration in honoring each thing’s proper place.
Read self-effacement through detachment, spiritual growth, and guidance.
shortened: The meaning of annihilation in the divine Tablets is that man should wholly annihilate himself in God--that is, become detached from all things and sacrifice to God his spirit, heart, body, comfort, joy, bounty, glory, and all personal conditions. He should transcend the pleasures and promptings of the mortal world, become divested of his human conditions, be kindled with the fire of the love of God, open his tongue in praise and glorification of God, become resplendent with the attributes of sanctity and detachment, and occupy himself with his own spiritual growth and the guidance of souls.

order.why: Keep love for people within the path of ascent.
shortened: Yet I know, O my God, that none can ascend into this atmosphere and no soul can rise into this cloud save through love of Thy loved ones and friendship with Thy chosen ones. For their love is identical with Thy love in the worlds of Command and Creation.

order.why: Consider the challenge to words and invisible claims without manifestation.
shortened: Today all the mystics who have claimed and still claim to possess mystical knowledge have contented themselves with the knowledge of an imaginary Invisible One, and with a mere word have they satisfied themselves in lieu of the spiritual realms. They have not yet grasped this truth: that every invisible must have a visible manifestation, and every word must possess a meaning. A word bereft of meaning can never yield fruit, and an imaginary invisible can never bestow wealth.

order.why: Consider the insistence that meaning have a visible manifestation.
Read the limits of pen and paper beside the receptive heart.
Make room for bewilderment as a form of knowing.
shortened: As to what you wrote concerning bewilderment - verily bewilderment is beloved in the Book, as expressed in His words "Increase my bewilderment in Thee!" Know thou in what place thou dost find thyself, morning and evening, in the vicinity of thy Lord's mercy, the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful. God willing, may your bewilderment also be in the knowledge of God.

order.why: Enter the vision of a luminous world within this world.
shortened: We have willed to bestow upon thee a remembrance of what We have seen, that thou mayest behold the luminous world within this world of darkness and be assured that We have worlds within this world, and that thou mayest thank thy Lord, the All-Informed. Verily, were He to desire to manifest from an atom the lights of the sun, and from a drop the waves of the sea, He is able to do so, even as He hath detailed from the Point the knowledge of what hath been and what shall be.

order.why: Consider the limits of narrow understanding without dismissing what it cannot contain.
Keep the reported distinction between creation, Truth, and mediating Will.
Read the journey from God to God within its stated ranks.
shortened: Were I to explain in detail, a book would not suffice and I would not be able to fulfill it, just as that divine mystic and knower of divine mysteries, the lordly Imam, mentioned a drop from these stations in defining the world of the heart, which has surely come to your noble attention - that the final rank of these three stations is the journey from God unto God. In this station and rank, existence is effaced from self and subsists through the Truth. All are from God and unto God shall they return, and "Say: All things are from God" is sufficient witness and adequate proof of this point, as the mystic of Rum has said:

order.why: Consider the Four Valleys’ challenging claim about love as a veil.
Hear the Bab’s prayer concerning love without an intervening claim of self.
shortened: And in mentioning the state, His words: "O my God! Thou art Thou - I have known Thee not through other than Thee. Thou art Thou - I have loved Thee not through other than Thee. Thou art Thou - I have desired Thee not through other than Thee. Glory be unto Thee! If I should mention the remembrance of love for myself rather than Thy Self, then there would be a veil between me and Thee.

order.why: Keep the Bab’s qualification that the complete tradition is not before Him.
Read different temporal stations within the image of crossing a bridge.
Consider the concise statement concerning past, future, and present.
shortened: Past and future in the sight of the people of mystical knowledge are identical with the present.

order.why: Hold differing capacities beside bounty beyond reckoning.
shortened: Indeed, each soul has an ordained capacity and every thing has a fitting rank and station wherein it is mentioned.

However, some are given a prescribed sustenance according to a known measure and reckoning, while others receive an undefined portion from the treasury of "Thou givest sustenance to whom Thou willest without account."

order.why: Read limited names beside customs beyond measure.
Consider the Point and its forms as the source’s metaphysical imagery.
shortened: The Primal Point, after traversing the realms of the Kingdom, appeared adorned with the seal of finality, and from its composition diverse forms became manifest, culminating in the Most Great Form. And from the different forms that were brought into being through the marriage of the Single Point, that which pertained to the Treasury remained in its own dwellings.

order.why: Read the Bab’s language of creation, effacement, and the speech of hearts.
Keep the paired lights and the knowledge of created things in their own complex wording.
shortened: O people of the two stations! Verily your Ancient Lord hath made this Gate the mystery of the two lights among the latter ones, the manifestation of the two appearances on the two mounts. He is the light upon the two foreheads, the luminary of the two luminous ones, the radiant one at the dayspring of the two easts and the two wests.

God hath not created anything save that the thing might know the knowability of its Creator within itself and might recognize His purpose in the creation of multiplicities and the descent of things from the plane of beginning to infinities and finalities, lest anything be ignorant of anything. All have known the mystery of the Gate in everything.

order.why: Consider the sea’s descent through named stations.
Read the small measure of light and the temples at the gate.
Join reflection on creation and self with the Bab’s language of hidden mystery.
shortened: And verily We know that which no one knoweth besides Us and the Person of the Gate, and verily God hath ever been, in truth, All-Knowing.
Do you not reflect upon the creation of the heavens and your own selves, with a swift reflection, in truth, with truth, through truth?
God hath placed in that Gate a mystery within the most hidden mystery, treasured. Soon shall ye know what ye knew not before, in truth, in the garment of the Sun, by leave of God, the Exalted, soon.

order.why: Keep the visitation’s language of Essence, attributes, and signs.
shortened: Then upon thee, O Thou Who proves the Essence by the Essence for the Essence, and the Beauty of Attributes in all manifestations, conditions, signs and evidences, by the light of my essence and by what God, my Sovereign, loves.

order.why: Read the concise statement of a hidden relationship across worlds.
Consider the hoped-for third countenance in the scriptural allusion.
Keep the letter’s claims about cosmic insight attributed to their source.
shortened: However, some among the ancients through the power of detachment gained knowledge of certain cosmic mysteries and obtained awareness of relationships and connections that exist between created things - they became aware of certain hidden secrets in the realities of things and deduced some future events from the relationships between existing things.

order.why: Read the reported account of worship and dependence in its particular conversation.
Consider the reported spiritual interpretation of apocalyptic signs.
shortened: The prophecies of the Coming of Christ were mystical. The prophecies concerning the Second Coming are also mystical. The earthquakes and unrest, the darkening of the sun and moon, the falling of the stars---all these foretell the humiliation of those whom the world considers great.

order.why: Keep the three baptisms as an invitation to symbolic reflection.
Read the quoted Shabistari couplet beside the image of the speaking tree.
Gather the prophetic images without collapsing their distinctive stories.
Hear many voices of Moses and Jesus in the sacred valley.
Read the call heard by Moses within the addressee’s experience.
shortened: Thou didst behold that spot round which circle the Concourse on High, and didst hear that call which the Son of 'Imran heard on the Mount of Knowledge.

order.why: Consider the unveiling beside the Qur’anic image of oil almost glowing.
shortened: Through the removal of the veil this bounty is attained - there is no intermediary. This station of manifestation and effulgence is from the station of "its oil would almost glow though no fire touched it."

order.why: Read the breast as Sinai and the heart as a reflecting mirror.
shortened: Thy breast, which is a lamp-niche for the flame of the knowledge of God, is Mount Sinai.
And thy heart, which is occupied with the remembrance of the friends, is a mirror reflecting the beauty of the free.

order.why: Consider the speck of dust and the breeze that breaks chains.
Read perceiving eyes and awakened hearts amid apparent concealment.
shortened: Although the Sun of Truth may outwardly be veiled by the clouds of concealment, were one to look with a perceiving eye, listen with a hearing ear, and ponder with an awakened heart, it would become evident that the splendours of the Most Great Light have grown stronger and the rays of the lamp of God waxed brighter, that the waves of His most mighty Ocean have surged higher and the outpourings of the heaven of His bounty have become more abundant and manifest.

order.why: Hear the invitation to perceive the realities of things.
shortened: The bird of heaven will warble melodies unknown save by the birds of heaven; then tear asunder the veil and see the realities of things with the eye of God.

order.why: Consider the receptive sense of smell as an image of renewed life.
Read the prayer for hearts and breasts to receive light.
Hear the prayer that the veil of self-love be consumed.
Keep the prayer for detachment and shelter.
shortened: Make me detached from the world and all therein, and grant me shelter and rest in Your protection. Make me independent of all else and grant me a portion and share of Your bounty.

order.why: Read the address to a dervish concerning detachment.
Consider the distinction between the mirage of fancy and living water.
shortened: If thou seekest the Friend, free thyself from the veil of fancy and intimacy with strangers. If thou seekest the light of the Sun of the Beloved, cease circling around the light of the candle. And when the mirage of fancy and imagination hath sufficed thee in place of the sweet waters of Beauty, seek not to soar with those who wing their flight in the atmosphere of love, nor desire companionship with those who have laid down their lives at the gallows of extinction....

order.why: Keep the prayer for guidance and steadfastness beyond attachment to names.
shortened: Ask ye God to guide mankind and keep them steadfast, for this Day is mighty, and until they cross over the gulf of names they shall not enter the Most Great Ocean. By the life of God! All are in a strange slumber.

order.why: Read the removal of ego and imagination in the source’s imagery.
Follow purification into wonder and astonishment.
shortened: In that station, place thy face upon the dust before the Lord of Lords and sanctify thy soul and spirit from all coming and going, that thy heart may be purified from all causes in the realms of creation. In the fifth, ascend to the heaven of wonderment that thou mayest taste sweet fruits in this holy atmosphere and become bewildered at the power of thy Beloved and the sovereignty of thy Creator, and say as did the King of existence and the Goal: "Lord, increase my astonishment in Thee!"

order.why: Consider the paradox of reaching the Tree of utmost love at the beginning.
shortened: They have traversed the Lote Tree of the utmost realm of love at the beginning of their journey and have perceived the ultimate goal of divine knowledge from the Tree of Paradise. They have found the sweet fruits of immortality from the dawning-place of the soul and have chosen solitude with the Beloved in the throne of the placeless realm.

order.why: Read the reversal of expected scale in the mystical journey.
Consider longing that neither cup nor ocean can satisfy.
Hear hidden abundance in people whose outward appearance gives little indication.
shortened: A hundred thousand seas of glory surge in their luminous hearts, and yet to outward seeming their lips are parched; a myriad rivers of holiness stream within their breasts, and yet no trace thereof is to be seen; the books of God's consummate wisdom are recorded upon the tablets of their hearts, and yet they breathe not a word thereof in the world of appearances. They dwell in the Egypt of certitude and journey in the lands of resignation. They are intoxicated with the beauty, and entranced by the glory, of Him Who is the All-Glorious.

order.why: Keep the reserved and exclusive language of the journey attributed to its source.
Read the prayer’s journey from God toward God.
shortened: I journeyed from Thee unto Thee, and by Thee I migrated toward Thee, until I arrived at the unseen Essence and the pure Face of the Self-Subsisting, and I recognized all stations in all that Thou hadst created in the dominion of Thy power and the kingdom of Thy might, and all that Thou hadst caused to flow in the heaven of Thy sovereign glory and the human realm of Thy all-encompassing holiness.

order.why: Consider the journey into presence leading to knowledge of ordinances and words.
Hear the personal account of longing, unearned grace, and wordless utterance.
Read ascent through the inmost being with the source omissions visible.
Explore the sea’s depths and the images of refuge along its shore.
Read the invitation to plunge for pearls of light.
shortened: Cast off these doubtful garments from the temple of existence and swim in this boundless ocean and plunge into the depths of this vast sea, that you may obtain the pearls of light and the hidden gems of the All-Forgiving Lord, becoming intimate with the fish of that Most Great Ocean and harmonious with the whale of the Divine Sea.

order.why: Consider the falcon, bird, fish, and heart in their linked imagery.
Hear the call to lovers, wanderers, birds, and thirsty fish.
shortened: O lovers, hasten to the gathering of the Beloved! O birds of the garden of truth, wing your flight to the rose garden of inner meanings! O wanderers, enter your true homeland! O ye who are distant, be delivered from the realm of deprivation and become intimate companions in the divine retreat! O thirsty fish, enter the boundless ocean!"
When those precious souls heard this melody, they ran to the altar of love and flew from the world of limitations to the realm of the infinite, reaching their heart's desire.

order.why: Read the tavern as a resting place for the soul.
shortened: The corner of the tavern of divine love is the resting place of the soul's abode, for the delicate, subtle soul soars only in the atmosphere of the Beloved and finds no dwelling place except the gathering place of the Friend.

order.why: Keep the tavern of love beside the winehouse of service.
Consider light, fragrance, and longing through the candle, gazelle, and lover.
Keep the demanding image of the arrow and its aim in its devotional setting.
Hear the prayer of separation and hoped-for nearness.
Read longing transformed into an address to God.
Consider attraction to the manifest Beloved.
Enter the Layli and Majnun imagery through music and longing.
Read the lamp-bearing seeker’s desire for human company.
Hear the quoted lover as a reed-flute dependent on the Player.
shortened:
O Love! I am by Thee bewildered and distracted,
And throughout all the world known for my madness.
In the book of those possessed, with my name do they begin,
Though ere this I was foremost among the wise.
O Wine-Seller mine! Source of my fervor!
From Thee comes my cry - I am the reed-flute, Thou the Player!
If Thou wishest me to live, breathe into me a breath,
For I am dead these hundred years, while Thou art Life like Christ's.
First art Thou and Last art Thou, Manifest art Thou and Hidden art Thou,
Veiled from every eye, yet in plain sight art Thou!

order.why: Explore flight without wings and eloquence without a tongue.
shortened: Since thou hast heard the sweet Hijazi melodies from the Iraqi Countenance, now hearken to the spiritual Shahnaz strains from the divine Falcon, that thou mayest perceive novel songs of faithfulness from the eternal lute and harp, and hear the melody of the divine pipe from the strike of the divine Unity, and step into the lane of the Beloved with all thy heart and soul, until thou becomest all spirit and fliest without wings, and art intoxicated without wine, and speakest eloquently without tongue, and attainest the stations of attraction, longing, ecstasy and taste, until thou forgettest sorrow and drinkest from the ocean of joy.

order.why: Read listening through the heart and speaking through the spirit.
shortened: Listen with the ear of your heart to what the dove warbles on the pole of infinity, insofar as it has taught you the paths of truth on that route that was raised up in light. Attest to this Tablet with the tongue of spirit so that you might be radiant with the fire of love.

order.why: Consider a soul hearing many melodies and flying toward light.
shortened: Therefore, as thou hast donned the new garment of glory and entered the living stream of mercy, hearken then with the ear of thy soul to these songs of the divine Nightingale, Who, upon the holy and spiritual branch, warbleth in all melodies, that thou mayest sacrifice thy soul in the eternal spiritual atmosphere and wing thy flight to the nest of the Beloved, until thy whole being becometh spirit and ascendeth unto the heaven of light.

order.why: Hear the Bird leaving silence through the fire of love.
Read the dove’s bewildering melody and reviving fragrance.
shortened: It is the melody of the mystic dove that bewilders mind and consciousness, and the sweet fragrance from the gardens of inner meanings that revives divine hearts and gladdens heavenly souls.

order.why: Consider communion that gladdens other listening birds.
shortened: O thou bird of the nest of the love of God! The accents of mystic communion that poured forth from the throat of the love of God reached the ears of these birds of the gardens of ardent yearning, engendering joy and radiance in the hearts of these thankful birds.

order.why: Read a letter as wine, flowers, and guidance.
Hear the written remembrance through fragrance and the trumpet.
shortened:
When thy musk-laden pen remembers us,
It earns the reward of freeing two hundred slaves."

Was this musk-laden breeze from Paradise that made all we possessed paradisiacal? Or was this the blast of the trumpet from the Tree of Sinai that made us transcend our very souls and join the Beloved?

order.why: Consider the physical messenger as a starting point for imagining the spiritual courier.
Read remembrance whose fragrance passes through books and utterance.
shortened: We have mentioned you before with verses whose fragrance wafts through the gardens of My books, the realms of My utterance, and the kingdom of My remembrance, the mighty, the wondrous.

order.why: Keep the language of scent perfuming the waters of Paradise.
Hear the preference for Hijazi melody in its particular address.
Read the remembered singer whose music moves the heart.
shortened: She said: 'He was not a professional artist but a mystic worshipper of the Beloved. His singing was not mechanical, but an outpouring of the joy felt in his heart. His poems were mystic and allegorical addresses to the Adored One. Through his music he spoke to the hearts and quickened and moved them by the power of spirit. He did not make himself a slave of technique or enunciation but he sang the living truth, the eternal reality, hidden in the chambers of human consciousness.

order.why: Consider music that draws hearers beyond name and fame.
Read singing and instruments within the garden of unity.
shortened: Rend your garment in love of the Beloved and soar to the horizon of ancient glory and raise the call of the Kingdom and play the lute and harp that nurtures the soul and sing uplifting melodies until the confirmations of the infallible Unseen appear and the outpouring of the Holy Spirit manifests and the rays of the Sun of Truth shine upon the horizons and the drops of the cloud of bounty rain down and adorn the garden of unity and the cypress by the stream of oneness grows tall and the nightingale of the rose garden of grace laments.

order.why: Hear the opening rain and fragrance imagery of Rashh-i-Ama.
Read the visionary scene of shared weeping and companionship in suffering.
Keep the Maiden’s appearance and refrain in their poetic form.
Consider the unveiling of the true lovers in the letter’s language.
shortened: O Prince of the realm of mystic knowledge! If that Loving Friend should, by the hand of His will, lift the veil from the countenance of His true lovers and remove all coverings, then wouldst thou behold hosts of enchanting ones who are the cause of tumult throughout all regions and the source of commotion and excitement in both worlds.

order.why: Hear the expansive celebration of affection through skies, gardens, and song.
Read the Bird of Light and Cock of Glorification in the scene of divine sovereignty.
Consider gardens, waters, birds, sun, and moon appearing together.
shortened: The gardens of the Kingdom were adorned, the pools of the Realm of Might overflowed, the sacred groves were embellished, the doves of Paradise warbled, the nightingales in the garden of the All-Highest trilled, the Most Great Sea surged, the Most Noble River flowed, the Ancient Luminary rose and shone forth, and the Ancient Moon blazed and appeared, dazzling with brilliant light.

order.why: Hear the risen Sun making the inward senses a garden.
shortened: O you who are our assembly of friends and our soul's beloved companions! The Sun of Truth has risen from the horizon of oneness. The earth became illumined, the heavens became radiant. The amber-scented breeze wafted, making the spiritual nostrils a mystic rose garden, a secret rosebush, and a flowering meadow.

order.why: Read creation’s movement through the One celebrated by the passage.
Keep the names, Tree, and cosmic response in the source’s declaration.
Consider the Tree’s unprecedented fruit and the invitation to perceive.
Read the account of glad tidings and trembling without inventing its unstated antecedent.
shortened: And I felt it stirring around my right ear as though it had come with glad tidings from God, the King, the Mighty, the Beautiful. When I turned my ear toward it, by God, it gave me such joyous tidings that I could not remain still within myself. I trembled, and everything that had been created between the heavens and the earth trembled with me.

order.why: Hear the movement from dawning to emergence through the dove’s melody.
Read detachment and rapture in the Point’s song.
shortened: The Point of Unity in this age of praise is singing verses of detachment, and the Eternal Dove on the everlasting branch is warbling with Abha raptures.

order.why: Keep the Nightingale and Dove at Sinai together.
shortened: The eternal Nightingale and the everlasting Dove are manifest and joyous on the right hand of Sinai with resplendent verses.

order.why: Hear the present days described through singing nightingales.
shortened: O friends! These are the days of the All-Merciful, and the nightingales of mystic knowledge are warbling upon the branches.

order.why: Read the urgent invitation while the gates of reunion stand open.
Consider the ocean before the face and Tree of utterance at the right.
shortened: The meaning is this: abandon thyself and turn to the Truth. The intention of this blessed word is not mere outward turning, but rather detachment from all that hath been seen and heard, and thereafter to observe and hearken with the eye and ear of truth and fairness. By the life of God! Then shalt thou behold the ocean before thy face and the Lote-Tree of utterance at thy right hand.

order.why: Hear the visible Rose as a summons to song and devotion.
Keep the hope that awareness of favors would draw people near.
shortened: I swear by the Sun of divine knowledge that hath risen from the horizon of the prison, were they to become cognizant of but a trace of His countless favors, thou wouldst surely behold them all circling round.

order.why: Read the Book as a letter that becomes an ocean.
Consider an ocean of meanings concealed within a letter.
Hear inexhaustible meaning in the image of rivers and seas beyond any ink.
Read the Hidden Words as chalices filled with inner meanings.
Keep the announcement of hidden meanings made manifest.
Expresses revelation through the language of concealed and unveiled mystery.
Read the recollection of Qur’anic recitation and sealed wine.
Consider the trumpet and broken seal together.
Hear the invitation after the flask is unsealed.
Read the chalice of salvation and the mysteries associated with the Name.
Consider the passing cups through several divine names.
Read the wine offered to those drawn near.
shortened: He giveth His unified servants to drink of His choice sealed wine, sealed with the finger of His power, and to those near unto Him that which causeth spirits to soar.

order.why: Consider the stated effects of the wine on detachment and love.
shortened: In this wine are concealed effects and hidden wisdoms. It sanctifies existence from all else save God and at every moment increases one's love for Him.

order.why: Keep the sealed wine linked with perseverance.
Read the prayer for an intoxication that endures.
shortened: We beseech God to provide thee with the wine of immortality which hath gushed forth from the springs of glory, that its intoxication may attract thee and its stupor may seize thee - and this is an intoxication that will never pass away nor change eternally.

order.why: Hear the concise counsel to drink inner meanings and look toward the horizon.
Keep the hope of receiving that wine at spiritual dawn.
shortened: God willing, through divine grace in this spiritual dawn thou shalt become one who partakes of the wine of inner meanings.

order.why: Read wisdom and recognition as drink.
shortened: You have drunk the wine of wisdom from the divine chalice and goblet, and partaken of the living waters from the spring of recognition.

order.why: Consider purity, mystic knowledge, and mercy together.
Read the sequence of wine, bread, eye-salve, shade, and fruit as thanksgiving.
shortened: Thou hast quaffed the choice wine of loving-kindness proffered by the Cup-Bearer of Divine bounties, and hast partaken of the bread of the All-Merciful from the banquet table of God. Thou hast anointed thine eyes with that sacred earth which is the collyrium of the chosen ones of God, and hast burnished thy sight with that musk-scented dust. Thou hast entered beneath the shade of the Divine Lote-Tree and hast partaken of the fruits of the blessed Tree that is "neither of the East nor of the West”.[Q24:35] Thou hast joined the assemblage of the All-Merciful and hast hastened forth, with thine entire being, on the path of the love of God.

order.why: Hear the prayer for streams, fruit, love, and shelter.
shortened: From the sweet-scented streams of Thine eternity give me to drink, O my God, and of the fruits of the tree of Thy being enable me to taste, O my Hope! From the crystal springs of Thy love suffer me to quaff, O my Glory, and beneath the shadow of Thine everlasting providence let me abide, O my Light!

order.why: Consider the feast, fruits, fragrances, and dwelling place together.
Read bounty through the shade of the Tree and the shore of eternity.
Hear joy through the passing cup mingled with camphor.
shortened: Joy upon joy and delight upon delight, for the cup mingled with camphor is passing round, and the soul-refreshing wine of the Forgiving Lord is flowing with utmost delicacy and sweetness like pure water.

order.why: Keep the cup circulating among friends.
Read the primordial Covenant in the language of wine and love.
shortened: Become intoxicated with the wine of "Am I not your Lord?" and dance at love's altar crying out "Blessed am I!" and "Would that my people knew!"

order.why: Consider the cups drawn by divine will as by a magnet.
Read the unusual image of food seasoned by unity.
shortened: O divine friends! Having adorned the food of glory and submission with the spices of unity and sanctification, enter into the verdant, joyous shallow waters of the Beloved Lord, veiled with the veil of light.

order.why: Hear the murmuring waters as a source of attraction.
shortened: O Hasan! Hearken to the murmuring of the waters of inner meanings which flow in the paradise of thy Lord, the All-Merciful. By God! Through its murmuring the hearts of the Concourse on High were attracted and the hearts of those who drank the choice wine of the Most Glorious from the Youth Who was named with Our Most Exalted Name were set ablaze.

order.why: Keep fragrance and fire as changing expressions within the source’s image.
shortened: Say: At times it is transformed by the winds and wafteth from the direction of the Ridvan, and at times the fragrance of the garment is diffused from it, and at times there appeareth from it the decree of fire and the hearts of the sincere are consumed by it in their love for God, the King, the Mighty, the Beautiful.

order.why: Read the prayer for an outpouring that brings rapture and gladness.
shortened: I take refuge at Thy spacious door and Thy vast threshold, and I call upon Thee, imploring and supplicating before Thee, to rain down upon this servant of Thine a torrential downpour and an all-encompassing outpouring from Thy most glorious Kingdom, that he may be seized by the rapture of the crimson wine from the vessels of Thy mercy in the most exalted company, and sway as one intoxicated, and be gladdened by the melodies of the nightingale of eternity in the highest heaven in the gardens of Thy oneness, adorned with flowers and flowing with streams.

order.why: Follow received nearness into praise.
shortened: When thou dost find the breezes of revelation and drink the choice wine of utterance from the cup of thy Lord's bounty, say:
My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having drawn me nigh unto Thee and enabled me to turn toward Thy horizon and for having made manifest to me Thy path.

order.why: Read the extended thanksgiving through music, light, awakening, and life.
Hear the Bab’s prayer recalling nurture and fellowship, with its omissions retained.
shortened: Thou didst then nourish Me with refreshing milk and didst rear Me in the arms of My parents with manifest compassion, until Thou didst graciously acquaint Me with the realities of Thy Revelation and apprised Me of the straight path of Thy Faith as set forth in Thy Book.

When that which had been preordained in Thy Book came to pass Thou didst cause Me, through Thy kindness, to reach Thy holy precincts and didst suffer Me, through Thy tender mercy, to dwell within the court of fellowship, until I discerned therein that which I witnessed of the clear tokens of Thy mercifulness, the compelling evidences of Thy oneness, the effulgent splendors of Thy majesty, the source of Thy supreme singleness, the heights of Thy transcendent sovereignty, the signs of Thy peerlessness, the manifestations of Thine exalted glory, the retreats of Thy sanctity, and whatsoever is inscrutable to all but Thee....

order.why: Consider the letter’s longing to reach a place of prayer and remembrance.
Keep the brief acknowledgment of the wanderer’s letter with its omission.
Read remembrance as Tree and fire, preserving the source’s ending.
Consider concealed pearls becoming manifest through words.
Read gratitude for insight and perseverance amid blame.
shortened: In any case, praise God that you have become aware of the mysteries of His Holiness Imam Hasan, peace be upon him, and have rent asunder the veil, and have not been troubled by the blame and attacks of the people, and have reached your goal.

order.why: Hear the call of the Simurgh in a concise personal address.
Keep the reported counsel for prayer alone upon a mountain.
Read the reported journey collecting new thoughts and proofs in its own voice.
shortened: I have journeyed through the unseen worlds and invisible realms of the Almighty collecting New Thoughts, New Conceptions, New Proofs and New Evidences.

order.why: Consider the refreshing effect of the garden’s music upon hearts.
shortened: Thus did they join the righteous and enter the garden of mysteries where they plucked the flowers and tasted the fruits, and heard the melodies of the birds and the vibration of the strings through the mystical flute that delights the ears, refreshes the spirits and brings life to the hearts of the virtuous.

order.why: Read light and breeze as images of renewed life.
shortened: Now, praise be to God, the spirit of reality has permeated and bestowed eternal life. The manifest light has cast its rays and illumined the region. The life-giving breeze is wafting from the direction of grace.

order.why: Hear the hope for souls to rise as stars, lamps, and flowers.
Consider lovers becoming angels of mercy and sources of guidance.
Read mystical knowledge becoming education that helps learners teach.
Bring the imagery into shared worship and servitude.
shortened: Burn away their veils and turn their gaze away from the earthly world so they may behold the pure realm, gather bouquets of yearning from the mystic rose garden, begin their servitude at Your threshold, harmonize with the songs of the celestial birds, and like the truthful ones, prostrate with this servant of Your threshold in worship.

order.why: Consider giving drink to others who yearn for it.
shortened: Take thou the cup of choice sealed wine and the crimson drink which restored life to the ill-fated dead, and give drink therefrom to those who yearn for it, according to the mystery of thy Lord, the Self-Subsisting.

order.why: Read the concrete invitation to travel and offer guidance.
Keep yearning and cosmic movement beside appreciated striving.
shortened: Then know that the star is piercing, the heart yearning, the sea surging, the tree blossoming, the House inhabited, the grave filled, and the striving appreciated.

order.why: Read unveiled beauty leading to shared remembrance and joy.
Close with steadfastness, enduring life, and praise in the garden image.
shortened: If thou shouldst enter therein, or if its lights should shine upon thy heart, thou wouldst abide within the sanctuary of God and stand firm in the Cause of God, and become everlasting in the realms of creation and the manifestations of grandeur. How blessed art thou, shouldst thou enter this eternal garden of the Ever-Living One, that thou mayest drink what none in all the worlds hath drunk and witness what none among those of old hath witnessed. Then say: Praise be to God, the Beloved of the mystics and the Goal of the sincere ones!

questions: What might it mean to judge an inward experience by its spiritual fruits?
How do the images of wine, music, gardens, and journeys express something that direct description may leave out?
How do the readings distinguish detachment from self-preoccupation while still calling for love, guidance, and service?
What place might bewilderment, humility, and careful discernment have in the search for spiritual understanding?
How does Paul’s insistence on charity illuminate the relationship between knowing mysteries and loving others?
Which neighboring subject—symbolism, poetry, mystical vision, or spiritual transformation—would you explore to deepen a question raised here?

references.note: Read Paul’s insistence that eloquence, knowledge of mysteries, faith, and even remarkable acts do not suffice without charity. Compare that challenge with the compilation’s test of spiritual fruits and its connection between ascent and love for others. What would make an extraordinary experience deepen ordinary human care?

subjects.displayTitle: Prayers for women: dignity, steadfastness, and a life of service
subjects.introduction: Leaves of a living tree, words full of meaning, rays and melodies, centres from which an endless light goes out: this is how Bahá’u’lláh and ‘Abdu’l-Bahá name the women for whom they pray. Often the prayer is placed in the woman’s own mouth, so that a handmaiden remembered from a distant prison learns to answer by remembering, praising and asking in turn. What she asks for is striking: to be a leaf no wind or tempest can bring down, to speak with eloquent utterance, to be held back by no veil of glory, and the good of this world and the next for herself and for every woman. Sorrow, hard journeys, hostile clergy and the ties of family all have their place, met with the plea for steadfastness and the hope of bringing happiness to everyone. Mary’s song in Luke, a handmaiden’s gratitude widening into mercy for the lowly and the hungry, keeps company with these petitions. The path runs on into prayers for particular people and for whole gatherings, and into the role and station of women themselves.
subjects.arc: Begin with dignity, lasting influence, and gladness; explore knowledge and spiritual agency; follow prayers for nearness, protection, and steadfastness; then return to shared remembrance, daily devotion, and service.

order.why: Hear the prayer for a daughter to bring happiness to everyone.
Open with women described as signs of love and words full of meaning.
shortened: O incomparable Lord! These leaves are the signs of Thy love and these handmaidens are words full of meaning and loving kindness.

order.why: Read the hope for effects that shine through ages.
shortened: O Lord, Lord! These are handmaidens, devoted, attracted, and enkindled with the fire of Your love. Assist them with the angels of the Spirit and confirm them with the breaths of the Holy Spirit so they may produce effects through which light will shine throughout all ages and centuries.

order.why: Consider eloquent utterance and the guidance of others.
Join service with rest, tranquility, and gladness.
Read the leaf that remains firm through winds and tempests.
Consider women as centers from which light emanates.
shortened: The light of man is not this effulgent quality from the sun and moon, rather it is chastity and purity and guidance and truthfulness and spirituality and attraction and submissiveness and humility and lowliness and contrition and evanescence and annihilation and utterance and expression and the essence of exposition.
I hope that the handmaidens of God become centers of the emanation of this endless light.

order.why: Gather the images of leaves, fruits, flowers, waves, words, and verses.
Read the prayer for a little maidservant’s happiness and fragrance.
Consider a young handmaiden as a ray and melody.
Hear the invitation to become a sign of greatness and bounty.
Read broken wings enabled to soar.
Consider the woman’s attainment of knowledge and her response in praise.
shortened: Most men on earth are deprived of the city of inner meanings, but thou, praise be to God, hast attained thereunto. Know thou the value of this most great bounty and mighty gift, and say: "My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me unto Thy path and illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and sent down upon me the rain of Thy mercy. I beseech Thee by Thy light whereby earth and heaven were illumined, and by Thy fire whose call was raised from the Tree of Faithfulness, to enable me in all conditions to remember Thee and praise Thee and to hold fast to the cord of Thy bounty.

order.why: Keep the contrast between her response and men’s turning away in its source setting.
Read the prayer for a receptive woman amid the opposition of religious authorities.
shortened: My God, my God! This is a fragrance from the fragrances of the garden of inner meanings that has turned to Thee on a day wherein the divines of Thy age and the clergy of Thy lands have turned away. I beseech Thee by Thy Beauty that hath appeared amongst Thy creatures, and by the power of Thy Pen and the penetrating influence of Thy Cause, to ordain for her through the pen of Thy bounty that which will draw her nigh unto Thee.

order.why: Join steadfast response with comfort and tranquility.
Keep the comparison with ascetics and nuns as the source’s particular claim.
shortened: O ye pure handmaidens of the Blessed Beauty! Praised and glorified be God that ye have attained the stations of nearness to the All-Glorious, while many ascetics and devotees, who take no account of the time of the day, consecrate themselves to the Adored One in the mosques and monasteries with heads constantly bowed in worship, and numerous holy women and nuns seclude themselves by renouncing the world and live in a state of continual fasting, have not.

order.why: Read the prayer for women unhindered by veils.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thyself and by Thy signs which have set the world ablaze, and by Thy Cause whereby Thou hast subdued the nations, that Thou make me to be among those women whom the veils of glory have not withheld, nor the veils of them that are gone astray, and who have shone forth from the horizons of the heaven of detachment with the lights of Thy Most Great Name.

order.why: Consider the prayer’s address concerning a sister and her spiritual journey.
shortened: This is My sister who hath believed in the Manifestations of Thy unity appearing in the garments of Thy eternity and recognized the Dawning-places of Thy constancy in the holy temples of Thy sovereignty. She hath ascended to the station that is detached from all save Thee and hath returned from Thee toward Thee.

order.why: Keep the elevated imagery of this particular handmaiden in its own devotional terms.
shortened: This is a handmaiden who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs, who hath entered upon the couch of holiness at the dawning-place of Thy Beauty and the dayspring of union with Thee, who hath reclined upon the throne of the divine Essence on the carpet of Thy glory and meeting with Thee, and who hath attained to the pure essence of grace when Thou didst choose her for Thyself, and hath been joined to the very essence of mercy when Thou didst select her for Thy love.

order.why: Read the language of belief and revelation without assigning an unstated identity.
Read private and public prayer joined with hope of nearness.
Hear the personal longing for the Kingdom of mercy.
shortened: O Thou Who art my Desire in the divine realm of existence! This is Thy handmaiden, who hath been enkindled with the fire of Thy love, attracted by the holy fragrances of Thy sanctity, and hath turned her face toward the Kingdom of Thy mercy and toward the court of Thy oneness.

order.why: Hear the handmaiden’s testimony to divine unity.
shortened: My God, my God! This is a handmaiden among Thy handmaidens and a leaf among Thy leaves who hath inhaled the fragrance of Thy Revelation and hath testified to that which the Tongue of Thy Grandeur hath testified, that verily Thou art God, and there is none other God but Thee.

order.why: Read assurance through revealed verses and proof.
shortened: Be thou assured, O My leaf, and say:

O my God, my Lord, my Master and my King! I testify that Thou hast manifested Thyself and sent down Thy verses and Thy proof and revealed that which was hidden in Thy Books and Thy Scriptures and displayed Thy power in such wise that necks have bowed before it.

order.why: Keep the direct invitation to hear the call.
Hear the personal address from prison.
shortened: O My handmaiden and My leaf! Hearken unto My call from the direction of My prison.

order.why: Read the assurance that a woman’s call has been heard.
shortened: O my handmaid and my leaf! We have heard thy call and have made mention of thee from the Most Great Prison. We beseech God to confirm thee in steadfastness and to aid thee in that which befitteth His Day.

order.why: Consider joy in being remembered from afar.
Read the enduring remembrance addressed to a spiritual leaf.
shortened: O My leaf, O My handmaiden, O My spiritual one! He hath made mention of thee, before and after, with that which its fragrance shall never be cut off, and hath revealed for thee that whose decree shall never change.

order.why: Follow being remembered in prison into thanksgiving.
Extend one woman’s gratitude into prayer for women and men.
Read thanksgiving for knowledge, guidance, and signs.
shortened: O My Leaf! O My handmaiden! Say: Praise be to Thee for having given me to drink, from the hand of Thy bounty, the wine of Thy knowledge, and for having guided me to Thy path, and shown me Thy signs, and sent down upon me from the heaven of Thy generosity the tokens of Thy greatness.

order.why: Keep the shared gratitude and hope of enduring good with its source omission.
shortened: When thou hast attained unto His utterance and found the fragrance of His garment, say: "My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided Thy handmaidens to Thy straight path, when most of Thy servants and creatures turned away from it.
O my Lord! Ordain for her that which will abide with her in every world of Thy worlds.

order.why: Hear the collective song of gratitude and the dignity bestowed on the humble.
Read the shared desire for service and heavenly confirmation.
Consider the collective prayer for insight, awakening, virtues, and refreshed hearts.
Hear women gathered as leaves and birds into unity.
Keep the prayer for five leaves in its particular group setting.
shortened: O my God! These are the five leaves from the tree of Thy mercy and the five handmaidens at the sacred threshold of Thy oneness.
Verily, Thou art the Chooser!

order.why: Read the collective petition for independence from all else, retaining its omission.
shortened: O Lord! O All-Bountiful! These handmaidens of the All-Merciful have set their hearts upon Thee and have freed themselves from all else but Thee.
Make these handmaidens independent of all save Thee, and cause these maidservants to become denizens of the Most Glorious Kingdom.

order.why: Hear the shared request for power to serve.
shortened: We supplicate upon the dust of lowliness and implore in the court of poverty and evanescence: "O Lord! Assist us through Thy all-encompassing power to serve at the gate of Thy oneness. Verily Thou art the Generous, the Merciful."

order.why: Read the assurance of continuing prayer for assistance.
shortened: I continually offer prayers at the divine threshold and express my utter helplessness and need, that successive confirmations may reach you and the lights of divine assistance may shine forth from the horizon of the unseen.

order.why: Consider the supplication for believing women’s success and prosperity.
Keep the remembrance of a group of women in a particular place.
Read the request that all handmaidens attain and act.
Consider spiritual detachment linked with doing what is loved.
shortened: Ask thou God, glorified be His majesty, Who speaketh at this moment, to assist the handmaidens of that land to do what He loveth and pleaseth, and to draw them to the realm of sanctity and detachment.

order.why: Join attraction to utterance with praise among other women.
shortened: One of Thy handmaidens, O my Lord, hath sought Thy face, and soared in the atmosphere of Thy pleasure. Withhold not from her, O my Lord, the things Thou didst ordain for the chosen ones among Thy handmaidens. Enable her, then, to be so attracted by Thine utterances that she will celebrate Thy praise amongst them.

order.why: Hear the prayer for a woman’s praise to reach all people.
Read merciful qualities beside service to the Kingdom.
shortened: O Thou kind God, suffer this maidservant of the threshold to become heavenly, angelic, merciful and celestial. Confer Thy providence upon her, reveal to her Thy mercy, Thy clemency, and aid her in the service of the Kingdom.

order.why: Consider the request for something enduring to be manifested through her.
Read women as bearers of glad tidings.
Join expanded understanding with a voice in the community.
Read freshness, speech, remembrance, and detachment together.
Consider protection of a fruit alongside knowledge and gladness.
shortened: O Lord! This is a fruit grown from the tree of Thy mercy. Protect her from severe winds and guard her from mighty tempests. O Lord! Illumine her face in Thy Kingdom and expand her breast through the light of Thy knowledge. Make her tongue speak Thy remembrance and gladden her spirit through Thy fragrances. Brighten her eyes through beholding Thy beauty and let her hear the melodies of the birds of Thy sanctity.

order.why: Hear the prayer for a leaf refreshed in the garden of knowledge.
Consider a leaf’s response and the petition for a gladdened heart.
shortened: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Thou seest how one of Thy leaves hath clung to the Tree of Thy Lordship, hath voiced Thy praise, and turned unto Thee when she heard Thy call.
Then ordain for her in the Supreme Tablet that which shall gladden her eyes and rejoice her heart.

order.why: Read the concise prayer for a leaf’s renewed freshness.
Consider a leaf stirred toward unity by love.
Keep the leaf’s response and promised bounty with the source omission.
shortened: This is a leaf who hath sought Thy face, who hath been moved by the breezes of Thy grace, who hath been seized with passionate love for Thee, who hath answered Thy call and turned toward Thy countenance.
Then grant her what Thou hast ordained in the heaven of Thy grace for the choicest of Thy handmaidens.

order.why: Read the leaf of revelation turning toward rain-bearing mercy.
shortened: O my God, my Lord, and my Support! Thou seest a handmaiden from among the leaves of the Tree of Thy Revelation, who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs and in what Thou hast sent down in Thy Books.
O my Lord! Thou seest one of Thy handmaidens who hath turned toward the cloud of Thy mercy that it may rain upon her the showers of Thy grace.

order.why: Consider a leaf’s nearness to the Tree and horizon.
shortened: O God my God! Thou seest one of Thy leaves who hath turned toward the Tree of Thy Cause and hath drawn nigh unto Thy most exalted horizon - the Station from which the Luminary of Thy Manifestation hath shed its radiance, O Thou Lord of Names and Creator of the heavens!

order.why: Hear the request for grace that encompasses earth and heaven.
shortened: O my Lord! This is one of Thy handmaidens and a leaf from the leaves of Thy Divine Lote-Tree, and she seeketh Thy all-encompassing grace which hath surrounded the dwellers of Thy earth and heaven.

order.why: Read the handmaiden entering the Tree’s shelter.
shortened: Glory to Thee, O my God! One of Thy handmaidens, who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs, hath entered beneath the shadow of the tree of Thy oneness.

order.why: Consider belonging to the Tree beside the fortress of protection.
shortened: O my Lord! This is a leaf from among the leaves of Thy Lote-Tree and a handmaiden from among Thy handmaidens, whom Thou hast related unto Thyself as a bounty from Thee. O my Lord! Protect her, then, within the fortress of Thy protection, and grant her that which Thou hast ordained for Thy leaves from Thy Most Exalted Pen.

order.why: Join the Tree’s shade with the ark of salvation.
Read protection and good extending through every world.
shortened: This is one of Thy handmaidens who hath turned toward the Kaaba of divine knowledge in Thy days and hath sought what lieth with Thee of the wonders of Thy favors. O Lord! Protect her within the tabernacle of Thy Cause from that which Thy good-pleasure abhorreth, then give her to drink of the Kawthar of everlasting life through the hands of Thy bounties, and ordain for her that which shall profit her in every world of Thy worlds.

order.why: Hear the prayer for protection and opened doors.
Consider care expressed through the eye and glance of mercy.
shortened: O my Lord! This is a handmaiden who hath believed in the Manifestation of Thy Self, who hath detached herself from all else save Thee, and who hath turned toward the countenance of Thy mercy, beseeching Thy protection in the shelter of Thy bounty and Thy safeguarding.
O my Lord! Guard her with the eye of Thy care and behold her with the glance of Thy merciful Presence.

order.why: Read forgiveness, shelter, and an honored dwelling together.
Keep the strong imagery of honor in its devotional setting.
Read the blessing for a spouse through light, shade, and a crown.
shortened: Envelop his noble spouse, the leaf of Thy Lote-Tree of the Uttermost End, with the lights of glory and majesty, and shade her with the clouds of might and beauty, and crown her head with the diadem of Thy mighty grace, O Thou Lord of the mystics.

order.why: Extend the prayer to a woman’s household and husband.
Consider the assurance of presence through shared remembrance.
shortened: O assured and confident leaf! In truth, you are present at all times in the blessed spot in the gathering of the handmaidens of the All-Merciful, and you are manifest and apparent in the assembly of the leaves of paradise, for your remembrance is their companion and your mention is their intimate friend.

order.why: Read mercy requested for a woman facing a difficult journey.
Hear the prayer for one who left home and reached the prison.
Read the traveler’s encounter followed by the wish for articulate praise.
Keep sorrow explicitly within the account of faithful response.
shortened: This is one of Thy handmaidens who hath turned unto Thee, acknowledged Thy oneness and confessed Thy singleness, and whom sorrows have overtaken in Thy path.

order.why: Read the brief acknowledgment of affliction.
Consider family ties, endured trials, and firmness in the Covenant.
Hear the prayer for women touched by tribulations.
Read the wish to shield women from sorrow and hindrance.
shortened: I beseech Thee, O my God, by the Word wherein Thou hast treasured the pearls of Thy knowledge, and by the Sea that hath surged in Thy name in Thy days, to ordain for Thy handmaidens that which shall preserve them from drawing nigh unto any except Thee. O Lord! I implore Thee by Thy Self to shield them from every sorrow and grief and from whatsoever may hold them back from Thy most exalted horizon.

order.why: Keep the petition for protection from hostile influence with its omission.
shortened: One of Thy handmaidens hath believed in Thee in this Revelation through which Thou hast manifested Thyself unto the people of Thy kingdom with Thy most beautiful names and most exalted attributes.
Protect her from the assaults of the evil ones who call the people unto other than Thee. Comfort her eyes, O my God, by gazing upon the horizon of Thy favors.

order.why: Read the prayer for protection within a setting of religious opposition.
shortened: O God! Protect Thy leaves from the transgressors amidst Thy handmaids who have turned away from Thy Beauty, giving allegiance to those who have refuted Thee and Thy Signs.

order.why: Consider sincerity and protection from harmful desire.
Hear the prayer for chastity, forgiveness, and freedom from doubt.
shortened: I implore Thee, O Thou Fashioner of the nations and the King of eternity, to guard Thy handmaidens within the tabernacle of Thy chastity, and to cancel such of their deeds as are unworthy of Thy days. Purge out, then, from them, O my God, all doubts and idle fancies, and sanctify them from whatsoever becometh not their kinship with Thee, O Thou Who art the Lord of names, and the Source of utterance.

order.why: Read forgiveness and the merciful regard requested for a handmaiden.
shortened: Therefore I beseech Thee to forgive and conceal my state in every condition, and to look upon Thy pure and sanctified handmaiden who is submissive to Thy Name, humble before Thy gate, speaking Thy praise, supplicating unto Thee, and beseeching Thy kingdom, with the glances of the eyes of Thy mercy and the gaze of Thy divine oneness. Aid her to that which Thou lovest and approvest in Thy earthly and heavenly dominions.

order.why: Keep the blessing concerning purified deeds in its source setting.
shortened: Thus have We commanded thee on this night, as a remembrance from One Who is mighty and wise. And the Spirit be upon thee and upon such handmaidens as God hath purified from the deeds of the ungodly.

order.why: Consider protection from fancies beside steadfastness.
shortened: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy light through which the valley flowed and earth and heaven were illumined, to preserve this handmaiden of Thine from vain imaginings and idle fancies. O Lord! Cause her to turn unto Thee and to gaze toward Thy horizon. Ordain for her that which will assist her to remain steadfast in Thy Cause, then grant her what Thou hast ordained for Thy leaves who have believed in Thee and in Thy signs
in days when all on earth turned away from Thee save those whom the hand of Thy power did rescue.

order.why: Read detachment from clamor and allusion in the prayer.
Hear the collective petition for steadfastness and attention to favor.
Join remembrance, praise, and firmness.
Read the prayer that received bounty become enduring love.
Hear steadfastness requested in response to the call from prison.
Read the prayer for great steadfastness for a remembered woman.
shortened: O my Lord! Thou seest that the Dawning-Place of Thy signs in this Prison maketh mention of one of Thy handmaidens, and this is due solely to her having turned toward the direction of Thy bestowals. O my Lord! Aid her to stand firm in the Most Great Steadfastness.

order.why: Keep the personal petition extending to other handmaidens.
Consider the single request for firmness joined with action.
Read the wish to preserve what has been received.
shortened: We beseech God to assist His handmaidens to preserve that which He hath bestowed upon them.

order.why: Hear the prayer for the preservation of faith.
Read faithfulness as a garment and love as a crown.
shortened: I pray God to make thee a maid-servant whose garment shall be faithfulness and the crown of her head the love of El-Baha.

order.why: Consider belief and the Covenant leading to action and protection.
shortened: O Lord! This is Thy handmaiden who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs, who hath been assured of Thy proof and Thy Covenant, who hath accepted Thy words, who hath circled round the Spot round which circle the Concourse on High, and who hath turned toward the Kingdom of Abha.
O Lord! Enable her to act according to Thy good-pleasure, gaze upon her with the glance of mercy, cause her to speak Thy praise, and preserve her within the shelter of Thy protection and care.

order.why: Join observance with an illumined heart.
Keep the prayer’s language of protection and observance without expanding its theological claims.
shortened: We beseech God to ordain for them the reward of attaining His presence, to adorn them with the Greatest Infallibility, and to aid them to observe that which He hath revealed in His Perspicuous Book.

order.why: Read response, encounter, and action according to the Book.
Hear the desire to share the path of faithful handmaidens.
shortened: O my Lord! Ordain for me what Thou hast ordained for Thy handmaidens who have believed in Thee and in Thy laws, who have circled round Thy will and Thy purpose.

order.why: Read the response of readiness to the divine call.
Consider the opened heart and desire for presence.
shortened: Say: O my God, my Lord, and my Desire! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which were opened the doors of hearts to the recognition of the Manifestation of Thy Self, the Dawning-Place of Thy verses, and the Dayspring of Thy Revelation, that Thou make me among those handmaidens who have believed in Thee and attained unto Thy presence and stood before the effulgences of the lights of Thy beauty and heard Thy most sweet call when Thou wert speaking forth Thy verses in the kingdom of creation.

order.why: Read the request to share the bounty of those who heard and responded.
shortened: O my Lord! I am a handmaiden among Thy handmaidens who hath turned unto Thee and faced the Source of Thy Cause and the Repository of Thy knowledge. I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the horizons were illumined and the lands were enlightened to ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy handmaidens who have heard Thy call and were present before the throne of Thy grandeur and attained unto Thy presence after Thou didst manifest the Manifestation of Thyself through Thy sovereignty and Thy power.

order.why: Keep the personal petition for the gifts of believing handmaidens.
shortened: O my Lord! I am a handmaiden who hath turned toward the heaven of Thy bounty and the horizon of Thy Manifestation. I beseech Thee by Thy Most Exalted Pen to ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy handmaidens who have believed in Thee and in Thy signs and who have circled round Thy throne.

order.why: Hear the hope to share in the life of those who circle the throne.
Read the appeal not to disappoint a heart holding fast.
Keep the longing for what has been ordained for faithful handmaidens.
shortened: O my Lord! Disappoint me not of that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones, and withhold not from me that which Thou hast desired for Thy handmaidens who have voiced Thy mention and praise and who have circled round Thy mighty throne.

order.why: Hear the plea at the door of grace and ocean of bounty.
shortened: O my Lord! Deprive not Thy handmaiden of the ocean of Thy bounty and drive her not from the door of Thy grace. O my Lord! Thou seest that she hath turned unto the Kaaba of Thy knowledge and asked for the wonders of Thy gifts. I beseech Thee to ordain for her from Thy Most Exalted Pen that which beseemeth Thy sovereignty.

order.why: Read the brief request not to be deprived.
shortened: O my God, my God! Withhold not this handmaiden from the heaven of Thy bounty and deprive her not of the ocean of Thy generosity. Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty.

order.why: Keep the concise plea for nearness.
Join undiscouraged hope with a gladdened heart.
Read the petition concerning what a handmaiden desires in God’s path.
shortened: O my God! This is one of Thy handmaidens who hath turned unto Thee, believed in Thy signs, and sought Thy presence and meeting with Thee. Write down for her, O my God, that which she desireth in Thy path.

order.why: Hear the concise prayer for a woman’s appointed bounty.
shortened: This is one of Thy handmaidens - enable her to attain unto that which Thou hast ordained for her in Thy days.

order.why: Extend mercy to every woman who responds.
Read the request for presence or its reward.
Keep the petition that no handmaiden be deprived on the blessed day.
Read honor and the reward of encounter together.
shortened: O Lord! Ordain for Thy Leaves that which will exalt them through Thy name amongst Thy handmaidens. Then write down for them the reward of attaining Thy presence and standing before Thy face.

order.why: Consider good requested through the images of leaves and fruit.
Hear the desire for nearness to the sea of unity.
Read the reward of presence together with good in both worlds.
Consider the opened gates of grace and bounty.
Keep the request for a gift befitting divine generosity.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued all things and whatsoever hath been created between earth and heaven, to send down upon this handmaiden of Thine from the kingdom of Thy power that which beseemeth Thy bounty and Thy grace.

order.why: Read the wish for what is profitable and draws her near.
shortened: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy greatest signs and by the breaths of Thy days, O Thou Owner of Names, to ordain through Thy pervading power for Thy handmaiden that which will profit her and draw her near unto Thee. Verily Thou art the One with power over whatsoever Thou willest. There is no God but Thee, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

order.why: Hear the request for every good through grace.
Keep the brief surrender to divine generosity.
shortened: Do with this handmaiden of Thine as beseemeth Thy generosity and grace. Verily Thou are the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous. Praise be unto Thee, O Lord of the worlds!

order.why: Consider trust alongside acknowledgment of not knowing what truly benefits one.
Read personal nearness and good in this world and the next together.
shortened: O Lord! I am Thy handmaiden and the daughter of Thy handmaiden. I beseech Thee by the lamp of Thy Cause and the ark of Thy power to aid me in that which will exalt me through Thy name. Then ordain for me, O my God, the good of this world and the world to come.

order.why: Keep the concise prayer for good in both worlds.
shortened: Say:

Glory be unto Thee, O my God and my Beloved! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Bounty, and by Thy Most Great Name, the Most Glorious, and by the power of Thy Most Exalted Word, to ordain for this handmaiden of Thine the good of this world and of the world to come.

order.why: Hear the companion prayer for the best of both worlds.
Read the request for what is best alongside service across worlds.
shortened: O Lord! Look with the glance of Thy mercy upon this handmaiden who hath stood before the door of Thy grace and clung to the cord of Thy bounty. Then ordain for her that which is best for her, and grant her the privilege of serving the Dayspring of Thy Cause in the worlds which Thou hast ordained.

order.why: Consider remembrance extending into the request for enduring benefit.
shortened: Remember thou thy Lord throughout all days and say: "I have turned unto Thee, O Lord of the mystics! I beseech Thee to number me among those who circle round Thy throne, then ordain for me that which shall profit me in this world and the next.

order.why: Read a sister’s gratitude that includes all handmaidens, retaining the omission.
shortened: All grace, O Thou Beloved of the world, and all bounty and generosity, O Possessor of nations, are Thine for having called me to the heaven of Thy recognition and the ocean of Thy reunion.

I beseech Thee by Thy name through which Thou hast conquered all the dwellers of earth and heaven, to ordain for me and for Thy handmaids that which will draw them close to Thee in every world of Thy worlds. Write down, then, for me and for them, from Thy Supreme Pen, that which will be of benefit to me and to them in this world and the next.

order.why: Extend personal consolation to other women.
shortened: O my Lord! I am Thy handmaiden and the daughter of Thy handmaiden. Ordain for me from the heaven of Thy bounty and the ocean of Thy generosity that which shall solace mine eyes and the eyes of Thy handmaidens. Then send down upon us from the heaven of Thy grace a mercy from Thy presence.

order.why: Join shared remembrance and firmness with good in both worlds.
shortened: I beseech Thee by Thy Light that shineth from the Supreme Horizon, and by Him through Whom all things have proclaimed, that Thou assist Thy handmaidens to remember Thee and praise Thee and to stand firm in Thy Cause. Then inscribe for them through Thy Most Exalted Pen the good of the world to come and of this world.

order.why: Read praise and nearness beside the sanctification of the divine Essence.
shortened: Say: O my God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy sanctification of Thine Essence from all similitudes and Thy protection of Thy Self from all likenesses, to assist Thy handmaidens in Thy remembrance and praise, and ordain for them that which will draw them nigh unto the shore of the ocean of Thy sanctification and the depths of Thy bounty and generosity.

order.why: Keep collective remembrance within all-encompassing mercy.
Hear the prayer for a woman to speak praise among others.
A handmaiden’s prayer for trust and conformity to divine will.
Consider prayer as continuing companionship and acknowledged need.
shortened: Become a sign of remembrance, and occupy thyself night and day with humble devotions and supplications. Show forth utter neediness and helplessness, and become an intimate companion in prayer.

order.why: Read the Aqdas provision for devotional practice during menstruation in its exact wording.
Keep the selected opening of collective supplication.
Hear the concise self-identification as handmaiden and daughter of a handmaiden.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! I am Thy handmaiden and the daughter of Thy handmaiden.

order.why: Read that address joined with hope of generosity.
shortened: O Lord! I am Thy handmaiden and the daughter of Thy handmaiden. I have turned to Thee, hoping for the wonders of Thy generosity and bounty.

order.why: Consider the hands of hope raised toward bounty.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! I am a handmaiden among Thy handmaidens and a leaf among Thy leaves. I have turned with my heart unto Thee and raised the hands of hope toward the heaven of Thy grace and bounty.

order.why: Hear praise among handmaidens following the Tree and unity imagery.
Read the prayer responding to the call from prison.
Keep the opening prayer that follows hearing the Tree’s rustling.
shortened: When thou hearest the rustling of the Tree of My utterance, say: "My God, my God! Thou seest a handmaiden from among Thy handmaidens and a leaf from among Thy leaves who hath turned toward the horizon of Thy manifestation, and hath heard Thy sweetest call, and hath witnessed Thy signs, O Lord of all beings!

order.why: Hear the request for strength to remember under all conditions.
Join remembrance and praise directly with service.
shortened: O Lord! I am Thy handmaiden and the daughter of Thy handmaiden. I beseech Thee by Thy resplendent Light and Thy gleaming Name to ordain for me that which shall enable me to remember Thee, praise Thee and serve Thy Cause.

order.why: Read the Book’s purpose of daily praise and steadfast love.
Hear the counsel to remember at evening and dawn.
Keep the blessing upon women who glorify morning and evening.
Read the blessing upon women who remember at all times.
shortened: And the Spirit be upon thee and upon those women who remember their Lord at all times and upon whom the angels brought nigh do pray.

order.why: Keep the personal remembrance of a woman who heard in Zawra.
shortened: The Glory be upon thee and upon every maidservant who hath believed in God, and upon My maidservant who attained in Zawra and heard the call of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Read the Tablet’s renewed attraction and blessing with its omission.
shortened: This is a Book from Us to her who hath believed in her Lord, that the melodies of her Lord may attract her once again from this Most Exalted Scene, the Spot wherein have shone forth the lights of the countenance of our Most Glorious Lord.
And the Spirit and Glory be upon those handmaidens who have believed in God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

order.why: Hear the blessing upon a leaf holding fast, with the omission visible.
shortened: O My handmaiden! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness.

Blessed is the handmaiden who hath attained unto My days and hath drunk the choice wine of love from the cup of My bounty, and blessed is the leaf who hath held fast to the Lote-Tree of My Cause and clung to the hem of God, the Luminous.

order.why: Keep the profession of oneness and closing praise in its supplied form.
shortened: O Lord my God! Thou seest that one of Thy maidservants hath turned unto the Dayspring of Thy Cause and the Dawning-Place of Thy loving-kindness, and hath acknowledged Thy unity and confessed Thy oneness.
Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the Most Great.

order.why: Read turning toward favor and the petition for endurance with its omission.
shortened: Say: Glory be to Thee, O my God! I am one of Thy handmaidens who hath turned her face toward the court of Thy favors.
O Lord! Cast not Thy handmaiden away from the door of Thy bounty, and grant her that which shall cause her to endure through the endurance of Thy sovereignty.

order.why: Hear the personal prayer of response and nearness.
Extend mercy to women turning toward the divine countenance.
shortened: And mercy be upon thee and upon those women who have turned their faces toward the countenance of God, the Most High, the Most Great.

order.why: Keep the shared blessing upon believing handmaidens.
Read the blessing that reaches women in their final abode.
Close with mercy for all women who have wholly turned toward God.

questions: How do the images of leaves, words, rays, and melodies express the dignity and contribution of women?
What relationship do these prayers establish between humility and the capacity to speak, know, act, and serve?
How do personal petitions expand into concern for other women, families, and communities?
What forms of strength are sought in prayers arising from sorrow, difficult journeys, or opposition?
How does Mary’s song of praise invite comparison between personal gratitude and concern for those who are lowly or hungry?
Which petitions might deepen your exploration of the neighboring subjects on devotion and women’s role and station?
