references.note: Read Mary’s song of gratitude, which moves from her own lowly estate toward mercy across generations, the lifting of the lowly, and food for the hungry. Compare this widening concern with the prayers for women’s dignity, steadfastness, and service here. How can humility become a source of confidence and care for others?

subjects.displayTitle: Prayers of praise and gratitude: remembrance that becomes service
subjects.introduction: Thanksgiving in the Bahá’í writings begins with noticing. Someone was hungry and fed, thirsty and given to drink, lost in a dark night and guided to morning; a stranger was made intimate, a homeless wanderer sheltered, a prisoner remembered. The prayers of Bahá’u’lláh and ‘Abdu’l-Bahá name such gifts one by one, as the psalmist bids his soul forget none of the benefits received [1], and the naming itself becomes praise. Yet praise here never rests in the heart alone. The breath that gives thanks for guidance asks to be made a pillar of strength, a refuge for others, a servant whose remembrance of God spills into improving the affairs of His servants. Nor is gratitude a denial of sorrow: it is spoken from exile, from grief over a son, from the plain confession that a feeble ant has been given Solomon’s might and that words fail. Learning to pray this way opens onto the wider life of prayer itself, onto thankfulness as a habit of the soul, and onto gratitude as its daily response to a world crowded with mercies.
subjects.arc: Begin with gratitude expressed through service and care; remember concrete gifts and renewal; explore humility, grief, and the limits of praise; follow recognition into daily remembrance; and close with shared worship and action.

order.why: Hear gratitude for sustenance, healing, consolation, and shelter.
Open with praise joined explicitly to improving the affairs of others.
Keep remembrance, praise, and service in one concise petition.
shortened: I beseech Thee to assist me in Thy remembrance, Thy praise, and service to Thy loved ones.

order.why: Consider the prayer to become a refuge and pillar of strength.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee to make this servant of Thine a pillar of strength for all kingdoms, a refuge from perils, steadfast in all pathways, and a servant of Thy Cause among Thy servants.

order.why: Read thanksgiving for the ability to perform a pleasing deed.
Follow arduous journeys into gratitude for the opportunity to serve.
shortened: O divine Providence! O Thou forgiving Lord! Sinner though I be, I have no refuge save Thyself. All praise be Thine, that in my wanderings over mountains and plains, my toils and troubles on the seas, Thou hast answered still my cries for help, and confirmed me, and favoured me, and honoured me with service at Thy Threshold.

To a feeble ant, Thou hast given Solomon's might. Thou hast made of a gnat a lion in the thicket of Thy Mercy. Thou hast bestowed on a drop the swelling waves of the sea, Thou hast carried up a mote to the pinnacles of grace. Whatever was achieved, was made possible through Thee.

order.why: Begin remembering gifts with creation, nourishment, and food.
shortened: Praise be to God Who created me by His behest, then nourished me through His bounty, then gave me to eat after I hungered. There is no God but He, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

order.why: Gather feeding, guidance, preservation, and healing into thanksgiving.
shortened: O thou who art firm in the Ancient Covenant! Stretch forth thy hands in supplication toward the Kingdom of Glory and the Dawning-Place of Beauty, and say:
Praise be unto Thee, O my Exalted Lord, for what Thou hast bestowed and granted, for how Thou hast fed and quenched, for how Thou hast guided and directed, for how Thou hast preserved and healed.

order.why: Read the prayer for recovery and its hoped-for gratitude without turning petition into medical assurance.
Consider the movements from thirst and fear into life and light.
shortened: I was thirsty, and Thou didst give me to drink from the sweet flowing Salsabil. I was fearful and trembling, and Thou didst grant me refuge and shelter. I was dead, and Thou didst bring me to life. I was in dark night, and Thou didst guide me to the luminous morn. A hundred thousand thanks be unto Thee!

order.why: Hear gratitude for guidance, safety, and a home for the wandering.
Read the stranger becoming intimate and the thirsty fish finding water.
shortened: Raise thy hands in supplication and prayer to the Kingdom of Glory and say: "O Lord! Thanks be unto Thee that Thou hast made this stranger intimate with Thee and admitted this destitute one to Thy shelter. Thou hast bestowed the water of life upon this burning thirsty one and brought this parched fish into the sweet Euphrates. Praise be unto Thee for this!

order.why: Keep shelter and solace beside guidance of the lost.
Read the prayer’s images of collective renewal and restored hope.
Consider gratitude for dispelled anxiety and expanded joy.
shortened: O God, my God! Praise and thanks be unto Thee that Thou hast sent down unto Thy servants a purifying draught through which their spirits have been cheered, their vision edified, their outward beings illumined, their inner realities sanctified, their faces brightened, their false stars blotted out, their hearts gladdened, their anxieties dispelled, and their breasts dilated with joy.

order.why: Remember creation and maturation through the imagery of nurture.
shortened: O my God! O my God! Praise be unto Thee! for Thou hast created me of the most excellent fabric, in the most honored form, and in the most exalted kind of Thy creation; didst nurture me from the breast of Thy favor, didst nurse me in the bosom of Thy mercy, until I grew up under the protection of Thy divinity, in the cradle of Thy training, and reached full growth through Thy favor and grace.

order.why: Read spiritual growth from childhood into maturity beneath the Tree.
Hear the Bab’s repeated joining of personal life with all things.
Enter the garden of revelation and its springtime fruit.
shortened: Magnified, O Lord my God, be Thy Name, whereby the trees of the garden of Thy Revelation have been clad with verdure, and been made to yield the fruits of holiness during this Springtime when the sweet savors of Thy favors and blessings have been wafted over all things, and caused them to bring forth whatsoever had been preordained for them in the Kingdom of Thine irrevocable decree and the Heaven of Thine immutable purpose.

order.why: Read spring rain and creation clothed anew.
shortened: The spring rain of Thy grace has made the world of existence verdant and flourishing, and Thy Most Great All-encompassing bounty has clothed creation with the new garment of the new creation. Thy favors have encompassed the world of existence and Thy benevolence has included the seen and unseen.

order.why: Consider the Naw-Ruz morning as a way of reading the world.
shortened: O Thou Glory of the Most Glorious! I have wakened on this Naw-Ruz morning to find the lights of Thy holiness gleaming from all regions, the verses of Thy unity recited by the tongues of all things, and the tokens of Thy singleness evident in the scroll of the Book of Creation. Blessed is he who chanteth them in such accents as to fill with ecstasy the Concourse on high, and to reach the ears of the dwellers of the Abha Kingdom.

order.why: Keep the companion Naw-Ruz prayer’s brief opening.
Read the winds and dawn within a compact invocation.
Imagine every particle of creation given a voice of thanksgiving.
shortened: O God, O Generous One, O Merciful One! I beseech Thee by Thy power which hath conquered all created things, and by Thy sovereignty which hath encompassed all existence, to ordain for every particle of Thy creation a speaking tongue in Thy remembrance, praise, and thanksgiving for Thy bounties and favors.

order.why: Hear the simple praise for love manifested to humankind.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O God, for Thy Manifestation of Love to mankind!

order.why: Acknowledge inability to offer adequate thanks within joy itself.
Keep humility, shortcomings, and hope for mercy together.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Thou seest me rolling my face in the dust of humility and contrition, supplicating toward the Kingdom of Thy Might, yearning for the contemplation of Thy Greatness, entreating Thy Grandeur, invoking at the Threshold of Thy Mercifulness, beseeching the realm of Thy Singleness, acknowledging my shortcomings, longing for Thy bounty, desiring Thy concealing veil and expecting the outpouring of the rain of Thy favor upon all the meadows and mountains!

order.why: Read the contrast between the known human heart and inscrutable divine Being.
shortened: Say: O my God! O Thou Who art the Maker of the heavens and of the earth, O Lord of the Kingdom! Thou well knowest the secrets of my heart, while Thy Being is inscrutable to all save Thyself. Thou seest whatsoever is of me, while no one else can do this save Thee.

order.why: Consider the prayer’s testimony to unity and transcendence.
shortened: I bear witness that Thou art the One, the Single, the Incomparable, the Ever-Abiding. Thou didst not take unto Thyself a partner in Thy dominion, nor didst Thou choose a peer for Thyself upon earth. All created things have borne witness unto that which the Tongue of Thy grandeur hath testified ere their creation. Verily Thou art God; there is none other God but Thee! From everlasting Thou wast sanctified from the mention of Thy servants, and exalted above the description of Thy creatures.

order.why: Read the Bab’s letter imagery beside the denial of peers or likeness.
A prayer affirming God’s transcendence above every form of created praise.
Consider the inadequacy of even all the letters of the Bayan to offer praise.
Read the complex language of letters, poverty, detachment, and glorification in its own terms.
shortened: For naught besides Thee, O my God, even if Thou didst create it through the Point, sufficeth me, O my God, for all are, like myself, poor before Thee and slaves in Thy presence. Should the servant look to aught besides Thee, it beseemeth him not to be mentioned before Thee, for the turning of one who is poor unto another who is poor is poverty without justice, and the independence of the servant from aught besides Thee is poverty without riches.

Glory be unto Thee, O my God, with whatsoever Thou lovest to be glorified before all things and after them, and from the right of all things and their left, and from before all things and behind them, and above all things and beneath them, and from the direction of all things and their encompassment - a glorification wherewith none hath ever glorified Thee before, nor shall anyone glorify Thee hereafter with its like; a glorification whereby they who glorify Thee may ascend to the summit of detachment, and whereby the sincere ones may rise unto the heights of inaccessibility; a glorification which Thou hast sanctified from comparison and purified from similitude; a glorification befitting the majesty of Thy holiness and the exaltation of Thy glory and the loftiness of Thy sovereignty and the splendor of Thy light and grandeur and the elevation of Thy Word and grace.

order.why: Hear praise spoken from solitude, exile, grief, and changing circumstances.
shortened: O my God! How can I extol Thy majesty on this Friday, knowing my own nothingness before Thee? Yet since Thou hast placed the signs of Thy Lordship within my soul, I commune with Thee in my solitude and exile amidst the mountains during these changing circumstances, that perchance the angels may hear my voice and call upon Thee due to my grief. Through this, Thou mayest look upon me with a near gaze that transforms my sorrow into the joy of the lights of Thy Self-Sufficiency, and my lamentations into witnessing the fragrances of Thy holiness.

order.why: Keep thanksgiving concerning what befell a son within its particular personal setting.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O God of Names and Creator of the heavens, for having strengthened me, made me know Thee, and accepted what befell my son in Thy path.

order.why: Read remembrance offered to one who has been wronged.
shortened: Drink thou the Kawthar of bounty from the hand of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, and say: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou in Whose hand is my forelock, and thanks be unto Thee, O Thou Who hast mentioned me when I was wronged at the hands of the servants.

order.why: Consider gratitude for being remembered while imprisoned.
shortened: When thou hast drunk the choice wine of revelation from the hand of thy Lord's bounty, say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having remembered me while I was in an impregnable prison. I beseech Thee to rain down upon me from the clouds of Thy bounty the showers of Thy mercy which have preceded existence in both the unseen and visible worlds. Praise be to Thee and thanks be to Thee, O Thou in Whose grasp are the reins of glory and majesty!

order.why: Hear the scattered flock’s vulnerability and dependence.
shortened: O Pure One of God! These are Thy scattered flock, and these are Thy bewildered and unsettled lovers. Though we are poor and lowly, Thou art our Helper and Supporter. We are abject and sick, Thou art the Glorious Physician. We are destitute and captive, Thou art the Great Wealthy One.

order.why: Read the instruction for moments of alarm and its testimony to divine majesty.
shortened: When thou art startled, say: "Glory be unto Thee, O God! O my God! Thou art the First, and naught is before Thee. Thou art the Last, and naught is after Thee. Thou art the Manifest, and naught is above Thee. Thou art the Hidden, and naught is below Thee. Thou art the Almighty, and none is Thy peer. Thou hast risen above all heights and drawn nigh in utter remoteness. Thou hast caused all the spheres to move at the testimony of Thy Proof, and the Pens in the Most Exalted Paradise have fallen still at the manifestation of Thy countenance.

order.why: Consider compassion for the downtrodden beside the source’s language of sovereignty.
Read the Bab’s personal petitions for parents within repeated glorification.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Send down upon my father at this moment in his resting place that which may comfort his heart. Verily, Thou art the Lord of all the worlds. And send down, O my God, upon her who bore me - verily, Thou art the Lord of all the worlds - whatsoever beseemeth Thy wondrous mercy, for Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful ones and Thou art the Most Generous of the generous ones. Thou createst what Thou willest through Thy command "Be," and it is.

order.why: Keep the testimony concerning faith and the Imams of justice in its source setting.
shortened: God bears witness regarding His servant that he has believed in God and His verses and was among those who are guided. My God, I bear witness to Thee by that which Thou dost testify for Thyself and for Thy favored ones near unto Thee among Thy servants, the Imams of justice who act according to Thy command and who are fearful of Thy might.

order.why: Hear the Bab’s blessing upon Him Whom God shall make manifest.
shortened: O God! Send blessings upon Him Whom Thou shalt make manifest and the letters of His Self among the people of Baha.

order.why: Read the blessing upon the Tree of oneness.
Consider the extended blessing through names, attributes, and the First Temple.
shortened: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Send down Thy blessings upon the First Temple, that with all Thy beauty it may be the most resplendent of Thy splendours; with all Thy majesty the most august of Thy majesties; with all Thy comeliness the most beauteous of Thy forms; with all Thy greatness the most mighty of Thy grandeurs; with all Thy light the most luminous of Thy lights; with all Thy mercy the most encompassing of Thy mercies; with all Thy words the most perfect of Thy utterances; with all Thy perfection the most complete of Thy perfections; with all Thy Names the most exalted of Thy Names; with all Thy might the most glorious of Thy powers; with all Thy will the most effectual of Thy behests; with all Thy doings the most consummate of Thy acts; with all Thy power the most far-reaching of Thy potencies; with all Thy sayings the most acceptable of Thy speeches; with all the things asked of Thee the most loved in Thy sight and the most securely treasured in Thy presence; with all Thy honour the most honoured of Thy honours; with all Thy sovereignty the most enduring of Thy dominions; with all Thy kingdom the most illustrious of Thy realms; with all Thy tokens of glory the loftiest of Thy tokens --

order.why: Read blessings extending from the Beloved to family and companions.
shortened: Glorified art Thou, O God of Names and Creator of heaven! I beseech Thee by the movement of Thy Most Exalted Pen, whereby Thou didst subdue all things, and by Thy Name which Thou didst make the Sovereign of names and the All-Ruling over earth and heaven, to send Thy blessings upon Thy Beloved, Whom Thou didst strengthen and exalt and cause to enter a station which the understanding of the world cannot comprehend nor the minds of nations grasp, and upon His family and companions whom Thou didst make the lamps of guidance among all creatures and the emblems of unity among kings and servants.

order.why: Keep the invocation through the Prophet, family, and companions in its exact wording.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Thou seest me turning toward Thee and holding fast to the cord of Thy Prophet and Thy Chosen One, Whom Thou hast made the Sovereign of the Messengers and the Guide of all paths. I beseech Thee by Him and by His family and companions to assist me in Thy remembrance and praise amongst Thy servants. Verily Thou art powerful to do what Thou willest. There is no God but Thee, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

order.why: Join inner meanings with knowledge, wisdom, proof, and evidence.
shortened: Glorified art Thou, O Thou through Whom the Luminary of inner meanings hath shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of utterance, and the worlds of knowledge and wisdom have been adorned with the lights of proof and evidence!

order.why: Read the quoted prayer of Kumayl linking all deeds with continuous devotion.
shortened: In the prayer of Kumayl ibn Ziyad al-Nakha'i it is said: "Until all my deeds and devotions become one continuous devotion, and my state in Thy service eternal." We beseech Him to give His servants to drink from the Kawthar of this exalted word.

order.why: Consider the companion invocation concerning lasting service.
shortened: Recite the verses of divine unity and magnify the Lord of peerless glory, "that Thou mayest turn every mention and invocation of mine into a single invocation, and engage me forever in Thy service".

order.why: Connect remembrance directly with action according to the Book.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O Thou at Whose mention all mention boweth down, and at Whose light's dawning all lights humble themselves. I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst subdue all things and didst open the cities of the Kingdom of Names, to assist Thy servants in Thy remembrance and praise, and to enable them to act according to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Book.

order.why: Read the response to a Tablet as a petition for service and remembrance.
Keep divine transcendence beside daily action.
Read praise, deeds, and contentment within a single petition.
Consider wisdom as a condition of praise among other people.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the pearls of the ocean of Thy mercy and the dawning lights of the sun of Thy grace to assist me in Thy remembrance and praise among Thy servants with the wisdom which Thou hast sent down in Thy Scriptures and Thy Tablets.

order.why: Join steadfastness with the commanded wisdom of public remembrance.
shortened: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by the sighs of them that are nigh unto Thee and the tears of them that yearn for Thee and by the pearls of the shells of Thy utterance in the ocean of Thy knowledge and wisdom, to aid me to be steadfast in Thy Cause and to enable me to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee amongst Thy servants with the wisdom which Thou hast commanded all to observe in Thy Books and Thy Tablets.

order.why: Hear the concise prayer for wise praise among others.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Aid me to remember Thee and to praise Thee amongst Thy servants with the wisdom Thou hast sent down in Thy Book.

order.why: Read speaking praise beside sincerity of face.
shortened: O Lord! Assist me to remember and praise Thee, cause my tongue to speak of Thy glorification and attributes among Thy creation, and make my face sincere before Thy generous countenance, O my Great Lord!

order.why: Consider the desire for a voice in great assemblies.
shortened: Loose my tongue to laud Thy name amidst Thy people, that my voice may be raised in great assemblies and from my lips may stream the flood of Thy praise.

order.why: Balance public utterance with communion in the depths of night.
shortened: Praise be unto Thee for having loosened my tongue in my supplications, that I might commune in the depths of night and call upon Thee with my heart and soul.

order.why: Read speech, writing, evidence, service, and freedom from self in one sustained prayer.
Keep enduring remembrance and recognition within the addressed prayer to Nasr.
Hear awakening and nearness remembered as gifts.
shortened: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having drawn me nigh unto Thee, and brought me into Thy presence, and honored me with meeting Thee, and given me to drink of the Kawthar of Thy utterance, and made known to me Thy momentous Message and Thy straight Path. I am he who, O my God, was heedless - the revelations of Thy loving-kindness taught me; who was asleep - the hand of Thy bounty awakened me; who was far removed - the manifestations of Thy grace drew me nigh.

order.why: Read the movement from lifelessness and silence into being and speech.
shortened: When thou hast drunk the choice wine of My utterance from the cup of My bounty, turn thy face toward the House and say: "Glorified art Thou, O my God! I testify that I was as one dead, and Thou didst adorn me with the ornament of being; I was heedless, and Thou didst make known to me Thy extended path; I was silent, and Thou didst cause me to speak through Thy bounty which pervadeth both the seen and the unseen.

order.why: Consider gratitude for being remembered while silent and still.
Keep recognition amid rejection in the source’s stated religious setting.
shortened: Say:

My God, my God! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant and the son of Thy handmaiden. Thou hast created me through Thy grace and brought me forth through Thy generosity and enabled me to recognize the Dayspring of Thy Revelation, the Dawning-Place of Thy signs, and the Manifestation of Thy Self on a day when most of Thy creatures turned away from Thee, violated Thy covenant and Thy testament, disputed Thy signs, and denied Thy proof and Thy testimony.

order.why: Read concise thanks for recognition of the Dayspring of mercy.
Hear gratitude for love and praise become a further prayer for nearness.
Keep recognition in the latter resurrection within the prayer’s terms.
shortened: Turn thy face toward the precincts of the Throne and say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, my Lord, my Master and my Beloved, for having caused me to recognize the Manifestation of Thy Most Exalted Self in this latter resurrection, and for having enabled me to voice His praise between earth and heaven.

order.why: Read guidance leading to praise among handmaidens.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me unto Thy straight path and made known to me Thy momentous announcement. I beseech Thee by the Most Great Name, whereby the hearts of the nations were thrown into commotion, to assist me in all conditions to remember and praise Thee among Thy handmaidens.

order.why: Remember knowledge and a personal mention in the prison of Akka.
shortened: When thou art illumined by the lights of the Luminary of utterance in the days of the manifestation of thy Lord, the Most Merciful, say: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having given me to drink from the cup of Thy knowledge and guided me to Thine all-highest horizon and the most exalted summit, and for having made mention of me in the prison of 'Akka.

order.why: Consider remembrance valued beyond royal treasuries.
Read the repeated thanksgiving for the table of kindness and unity.
Follow remembrance into service, praise, and shelter.
Gather the images of ocean, horizon, path, and illumined heart.
shortened: When thou dost inhale its fragrance say: "My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having caused me to recognize the Dayspring of Thy signs, and shown me the waves of the ocean of Thy utterance, and enabled me to behold the horizon of Thy Revelation, and guided me to Thy path, and honored me with Thy traces, and illumined my heart with the lights of Thy knowledge.

order.why: Hear recognition and the straight path in a concise act of praise.
shortened: Say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, and glory be to Thee, O my Aim, and greatness and laudation be to Thee, O my Beloved, for having confirmed me in recognition and made known to me Thy straight path and Thy mighty Message.

order.why: Keep the source’s contrast with religious authorities in its particular setting.
Read guidance, hearing, and receiving drink amid rejection.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me, caused me to hear, given me to drink, and made me turn toward the court of Thy glory after the turning away of most of Thy creatures.

order.why: Follow received knowledge into prayer for opened doors of bounty.
shortened: When thou hearest My call and drinkest the choice wine of My utterance, turn thy face toward the Kaaba of My Revelation and say: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me and given me to drink and caused me to know Thee. I beseech Thee by Thy most great signs and by the lights of Thy countenance from the most sublime horizon, and by Thy Name through which Thou didst subdue the kingdom of names, to open before my face the doors of Thy grace and bounty, then send down upon me from the clouds of Thy generosity the rain of Thy munificence.

order.why: Consider utterance as a life-giving drink.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having given me to drink from the Kawthar of Thy utterance in Thy days and for having made me to know the Dawning-Place of Thy verses and the Dayspring of Thy clear tokens.

order.why: Let the repeated refrain trace guidance through hearing and sight into service.
shortened: Say: Glory be to Thee, O my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me. Glory be to Thee, O my God! Praise be to Thee for having made me know Thee. Glory be to Thee, O my God! Praise be to Thee for having honored me, brought me into Thy presence, caused me to hear and to see. Glory be to Thee, O my God! Praise be to Thee for having favored me, enabled me to serve Thee, and caused me to speak forth Thy praise and glorification.

order.why: Read recognition through the images of dawning light and an ocean of knowledge.
Hear praise for revelation and its generosity.
shortened: When thou hast attained unto My Tablet and beheld the stars of the heaven of My utterance, say:

My God, my God! Unto Thee be praise and glory, and unto Thee be thanksgiving and splendor, for having manifested the Dawning-Place of Thy verses and the Dayspring of Thy clear tokens and the Manifestation of Thy Self and the Source of Thy knowledge and the Ocean of Thy generosity and bounty.

order.why: Consider illumination whose fragrance endures.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and sent down unto me from the clouds of Thy bounty that whose fragrance shall never cease throughout the duration of Thy dominion and Thy kingdom.

order.why: Read being remembered through the image of an enduring Book.
shortened: When the fragrance of the Tablet taketh hold of thee, arise and say: "Glory be unto Thee, O my God! All praise be unto Thee for having remembered me and all glory be unto Thee for having sent down upon me from the heaven of Thy grace that which shall immortalize me in Thy Manifest Book.

order.why: Join gratitude for guidance with mindfulness of verses.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who art the Goal of the world and the Beloved of the nations, for having guided me unto Thy path, shown me Thy way, and sent down for me Thy proof. I beseech Thee to ordain that I may, in all conditions, be mindful of Thy verses and hold fast unto the cord of Thy Cause.

order.why: Hear thanks for the call and the traces of the Pen.
shortened: When thou hearest My call and attainest unto My Tablet, say: "My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having caused me to hear Thy most sweet call and shown me the traces of Thy Most Exalted Pen.

order.why: Read the addressed leaf’s gratitude for strength and hearing.
shortened: O My leaf! When thou hast attained unto My Tablet and heard My call, say:
My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having strengthened me and made me recognize Thee and guided me and caused me to hear Thy most sweet call as it was raised betwixt earth and heaven.

order.why: Keep the source’s contrast between righteousness and rejection explicit.
shortened: Say: All praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having guided me unto the path of righteousness and for having caused me to turn toward Thee and to turn away from those who have denied Thy Self and rejected Thy proof.

order.why: Read garment, tree, trumpet, and light as images of received grace.
Consider strengthening and approaching the gate of bounty.
Read awakening and guidance beside the source’s account of surrounding heedlessness.
shortened: When you have taken the cup of knowledge in My Name and drunk thereof through My love, turn your face toward the Most Great House of God and say: "My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me when people were in manifest error. Glory be to Thee for having strengthened me when the people were behind a thick veil. Thanks be to Thee for having awakened me when the servants were in strange slumber.

order.why: Gather the distinct gifts of teaching, hearing, seeing, and remembrance.
Keep the prison setting within the prayer of thanksgiving.
Read knowledge and eternity through the images of light and drink.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me through Thy loving-kindness and illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and given me to drink of the Kawthar of Thy eternity from the hand of Thy bounty.

order.why: Hear the particular address to Muhammad-Qabli-Rida.
Consider the opened door of knowledge and the shown path.
shortened: When thou hast attained unto the Tablet of God and its effects, say: "My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having opened before my face the door of Thy knowledge, and made known to me Thy path, and shown me Thy signs, and strengthened me in that which most of Thy creatures were hindered from.

order.why: Read heart and sight illumined through utterance.
Keep the concise gratitude for knowledge and turning toward God.
shortened: Glorify your Lord, then praise Him and say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and enabled me to turn toward Thee.

order.why: Hear thanksgiving for remembrance that draws one nearer.
Read trust accompanying recognition of the source’s stated Manifestation.
shortened: Put thy trust in God, thy Lord, and say: "Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having made known unto me the Dayspring of Thy signs, the Dawning-Place of Thy lights, and the Manifestation of Thy Self, before Whom, when He appeared, all necks bowed down in submission.

order.why: Consider the table of inner meanings sent through remembrance.
shortened: Say: "My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having remembered me and Thy servants through Thy Most Exalted Pen, and for having sent down from the heaven of Thy bounty the table of inner meanings and utterance.

order.why: Read the made-clear path and manifested proof.
shortened: When thou attainest the presence of revelation and hearest the shrill voice of My Pen, say:

"Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having made clear to me Thy path, and for having sent down to me Thy proof, and for having manifested what was hidden in Thy knowledge - a grace from Thee unto Thy loved ones.

order.why: Hear gratitude for guidance and the water of immortality.
shortened: When thou attainest unto it and findest the fragrance of revelation, say: "My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having given me to drink the Kawthar of immortality from the hands of Thy bounty, and thanks be to Thee for having guided me unto Thy path.

order.why: Consider endurance of name and memory as a received bounty.
Read knowledge of hidden things and guidance without extending the source’s claims.
shortened: Rejoice thou in this most great favor and say: "Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having made known unto me the Dawning-Place of Thy mighty signs and taught me what was hidden in Thy knowledge and guided me unto Thy mighty, extended Path."

order.why: Hear the invocation of the All-Loving amid the wine imagery.
Join illumination of heart with enduring remembrance.
shortened: When thou attainest unto the Tablet of God and its traces, say:
"My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and for having sent down unto me that which shall cause my remembrance to endure in Thy Book.

order.why: Read recognition and personal mention from the Most Great Prison.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having enabled me to recognize the Dayspring of Thy Revelation and the Dawning-Place of Thy knowledge, and for having given me to drink of the wine of Thy bounty in such wise that I have turned my face unto Thy face and been honored by Thy favors to such extent that Thou hast mentioned me in Thy Most Great Prison.

order.why: Keep thanksgiving for remembrance in Akka.
Consider movement from the drink of utterance toward the ocean of knowledge.
shortened: Say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having given me to drink from the Kawthar of Thy utterance and guided me to the ocean of Thy knowledge.

order.why: Read acknowledgment of the Books of Prophets and Messengers.
Keep the specific mention of the Afnans and the command to show them affection.
Hear turning toward bounty and speaking praise in concise form.
Read the signs of generosity descending through utterance.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee for having sent down to me from the heaven of Thy utterance the signs of Thy generosity and grace.

order.why: Consider remembrance as an ornament of being.
Hear gratitude for presence and the heard voice.
Join recognition with the lights of love.
shortened: Say: O my Lord! All praise be unto Thee for having made me recognize the Manifestation of Thy Self and cast into my heart the lights of love and sent unto me a Book of glory most bountiful. Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for this great bounty and mighty gift.

order.why: Read the sequence of hearing, guidance, sight, and being summoned.
Respond to the Most Great Ocean with arising in thanks.
shortened: Arise then to render thanks and praise, for He hath guided thee to the Most Great Ocean and caused thee to be mentioned by the Most Exalted Pen.

order.why: Read the request for remembrance under all conditions.
shortened: When you perceive its fragrance and read its verses, say:

"Glory be to Thee, O my God! Thine are the bounty and the favors. I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name through which Thou didst separate between the nations and didst manifest what was hidden in Thy knowledge and treasured in the repository of Thy wisdom, to make me aided in all conditions to remember Thee and praise Thee.

order.why: Consider praise arising from the fragrance and living water imagery.
shortened: When thou findest the fragrance of the Robe, and the intoxication of the living Kawthar---distilled from the ocean of the mercy of My Name, the All-Merciful---seizeth thee, then say: Praise be to Thee, O Thou Who hast, through Thy Name, moved my most exalted Pen. I bear witness that Thou art the Lord of the servants and the Nurturer of all who are in earth and heaven.

order.why: Hear the prayer for lasting remembrance within divine Scriptures.
Read firmness as a gift that enables speech.
shortened: Raise thou thy hands in gratitude to the threshold of divine unity and say:
'O God! O Thou sanctified Lord! A myriad thanks be offered up to Thee for Thou hast made me firm in Thy Cause, and enabled me to speak out in Thy praise.

order.why: Keep the brief glorification of the Creator.
shortened: Glorified art Thou, O God! Thou art the Creator of the heavens and earth, the Ordainer of command and creation.

order.why: Join attraction to verses with detachment and thanksgiving.
shortened: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, and thanksgiving be unto Thee, O my Beloved, and glory be unto Thee, O Glory of those who are in the heavens and on earth, for having caused me to turn toward Thee and to speak Thy praise and to be attracted by Thy verses and to be detached from all else besides Thee.

order.why: Read moment-by-moment prayer with its source omission visible.
Hear gratitude for success in a particular undertaking.
Consider the nightingale’s praise as an image for the praying voice.
Gather the series of gifts in a simple thanksgiving.
Read the desire for mercy and unhindered remembrance.
shortened: O my Lord! Thou seest me turning unto Thee and detached from all else save Thee. Have mercy upon me, O my God, through the wonders of Thy mercy; then grant me to drink from the Kawthar of Thy bounty. Then enable me, O my God, to remember and praise Thee in such wise that the veils of them who are heedless of the Dayspring of Thy most beautiful names and the Dawning-Place of Thy most exalted attributes shall not prevent me.

order.why: Consider remembrance throughout nights and days.
shortened: Say: My God, my God! I perceive the fragrance of Thy bounty from Thy utterance and behold the lights of Thy daybreak from Thy horizon. I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst manifest the Resurrection and its conditions, and the Hour and its signs, and through which Thou didst subdue the servants and send down upon the lands that which was inscribed by Thy Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Tablet, to enable me to remember Thee and praise Thee throughout the nights and days.

order.why: Hear the prayer not to be deterred by books, intimations, or riches.
shortened: O my Lord! I beseech Thee to assist me under all conditions to remember and praise Thee in such wise that neither the books of the world nor the intimations of the nations shall prevent me, and to ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones whom neither souls nor bodies nor riches deterred from Thy love.

order.why: Keep the invocation for assistance through divine power.
Read the brief command to be thankful and its prayer.
shortened: Be thankful and say: "Praise be unto Thee, O Master of existence, and glorified be Thou, O Lord of Lords!"

order.why: Join nourishment through generosity with praise among humankind.
Consider the rhythm of dawn, dusk, night, and day.
shortened: Then make the hearts of the pure ones throb with Thy remembrance at dawn and dusk, their tongues speak Thy praise night and day, and their breasts expand with the signs of Thy oneness in the early hours.

order.why: Keep the concise invitation to turn and speak.
shortened: Turn your faces to the sanctified Kingdom and open your tongues in praise of the Ancient of Days.

order.why: Hear the request for a voice of praise among others.
shortened: Make him speak in praise of Thy Self amidst Thy creation. Verily, Thou art the Generous, the Possessor of wondrous grace.

order.why: Read the brief petition for exalted remembrance.
Consider loved ones and the mysteries of the Book within supplication.
shortened: I beseech Thee by the lights of the faces of Thy loved ones and the mysteries hidden in Thy Book to enable me to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee.

order.why: Join attraction and nearness with enduring remembrance.
shortened: O Lord! I beseech Thee by the breath whereby hearts and souls were attracted, in such wise that they hastened to the river of Thy nearness and drank from the choice wine of Thy love, to assist me in Thy remembrance and praise and in that whereby my mention may endure among Thy servants.

order.why: Hear the short invocation to the light of hearts.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O Light of hearts and Manifest One through Thy beloved Name! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Book, which none among the nations hath comprehended, to illumine the hearts of Thy loved ones with the light of Thy knowledge.

order.why: Read the invocation embracing seen and unseen existence.
Keep praise together with lasting steadfastness.
Read former heedlessness remembered in a prayer for firmness.
Consider rejoicing joined with humility.
Read the lamp of oneness sustained by wisdom and protected by power.
Hear the concise thanksgiving addressed to the Beloved of earth and heaven.
shortened: Be thankful to your Lord for this most great favor and say: "Praise be unto Thee, O Lord of the world, and glory be unto Thee, O Beloved of those who are in the heavens and on earth!"

order.why: Keep the brief gratitude addressed to the Beloved of mystics.
Read the prayer opening addressed to the guide of the wandering.
shortened: O thou who circlest in adoration about the Spot round which circle the Concourse on high! Raise thou thy hands in gratitude at the Threshold of the one true God, and say:
O Thou the highest aspiration of every ardent lover! O Thou the Guide of every wandering soul!

order.why: Hear thanksgiving for gifts while preserving its internal omission.
shortened: Praise be unto Thee for what Thou hast bestowed, and thanks be unto Thee for what Thou hast granted. Thou givest to whomsoever Thou willest, and confirmest whomsoever Thou willest, and guidest whomsoever Thou willest to whatsoever Thou willest.
Verily Thou art the Bestower, the Giver, the Generous, the Merciful.

order.why: Follow freedom from attachments into joy, righteousness, and shared guidance.
shortened: O Lord! Deliver us from the attachments of the world and its peoples, from the transgressions of the past, and from the afflictions yet to come, that we may arise to exalt Thy Word with the utmost joy and radiance and celebrate Thy praise in the daytime and in the night season, that we may summon all people to the way of guidance and enjoin them to observe righteousness, and that we may chant the verses of Thy unity amidst all Thy creation. Potent art Thou to do what pleaseth Thee.

order.why: Read the prayer for a community as lamps of unity.
shortened: O Lord! Assist them through Thy grace and favor, strengthen them through Thy might and sovereignty, teach them Thy proof and evidence, cause them to speak Thy praise, make their faces sincere before Thy face, illumine their hearts with Thy remembrance, expand their breasts through Thy verses, gather their souls beneath Thy banners, and make them the lamps of unity, the emblems of sanctity, and the lights of detachment, that they may shine with Thy mention throughout all regions and be illumined by Thy radiant light from the dawning-place of effulgence.

order.why: Hear a gathered assembly’s call to service.
Extend the prayer for knowledge and praise to both women and men.
Consider shared renewal through love and the signs of oneness.
shortened: O God! My Lord, my Master, my Refuge! These are servants who have purified their faces for Your greatness and sovereignty, and have sanctified their souls through Your love and recognition, and have revived their spirits through a breeze that wafted from the gardens of Your holiness, and have expanded their breasts through the manifest signs of Your oneness in the horizons of Your lands.

order.why: Keep the collective address of servants holding fast to grace.
shortened: O my Lord! My Lord! These are servants who have been attracted by Thy holy fragrances and have been set ablaze with the fire of Thy love and have held fast to the hem of Thy grace.

order.why: Read hearts and spirits refreshed through companionship.
Consider the gathered realities becoming ready to receive light.
shortened: Praise be to Him Who caused the Dove to speak in praise of the Sun of Glory, and illumined the highest heaven with one of His Most Beautiful Names, and showered upon the sanctified realities an outpouring from the Supreme Example and the Most Exalted Reality, whereupon they were revived and expanded and were attracted and rejoiced and were joined and gathered and made ready and became worthy of the manifestation of lights from the Luminary of Mysteries.

order.why: Join thanksgiving for fulfilled action with the stated freedom from personal gain.
shortened: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Praise be unto Thee for having enabled Thy loved ones to carry out Thy command and manifest that which Thou didst desire through Thy sovereignty. O Lord! Thou knowest that I desired for no one save Thy remembrance and praise, and sought from no soul that which Thou hadst bestowed through Thy bounty and favor. I summoned them in all conditions purely for Thy sake to the court of Thy grace.

order.why: Read the prayer that past efforts become a lasting treasure.
Consider helping, supporting, and bearing witness for others.
Bring yearning into praise and steadfast service.
shortened: Say:

Glorified art Thou, O Thou at Whose separation the hearts of those near unto Thee among Thy servants have melted, and at Whose remoteness the tears of the sincere ones among Thy creatures have fallen! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst cause the mountains to be scattered in dust and the earth to become a level plain, and by the Most Great Word whereby Thou didst subdue all who are in earth and heaven, to make me in all conditions strengthened through Thy loving-kindness, speaking Thy praise, and standing firm in service to Thy Cause.

order.why: Read service leading to prayer for others’ joy and tranquility.
Close with remembrance that awakens and brings joy to other hearts.
shortened: Say: Remember the Lord in such wise that every slumberer may be awakened thereby and the hearts of those who have turned to the Qiblih of all who are in the heavens and on earth may rejoice.

questions: Which concrete gifts do these prayers ask the reader to notice, and how might that attention change daily life?
How does thanksgiving lead into requests to serve others or improve their affairs?
What do prayers spoken amid exile, sorrow, need, or imprisonment suggest about gratitude?
How do humility and the acknowledged limits of language shape the act of praise?
How does Psalm 103’s practice of remembering benefits illuminate the forms of remembrance in this compilation?
What might continuous devotion mean when explored alongside the neighboring subjects on prayer and thankfulness?

references.label: 1 · Psalm 103:1–5 · Remembering what has been received
references.note: Read the psalm’s call to remember divine benefits, including forgiveness, healing, lovingkindness, and renewal. Compare this practice of attention with the prayers that recall guidance, shelter, nourishment, and service. How might remembrance change the way a person responds to present needs?
